items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: They called me Quee pee, that was my name, Que-pee. That was my nickname.

ctx.x: One of the guys would ask me -- a train whistle would blow, or different sounds. What note was that Quinn? They called me Quee pee, that was my name, Que-pee. That was my nickname. What note was that, Que-pee?
Was this with the Earl Hines band?
